list: PlayStation 5 trophy list supplied for this entry

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlock the other 54 trophies; this platinum is the final checklist reward. No separate action is listed. The supplied PS5 trophy list does not identify any missable trophies. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing. The list gives no mission choices or failure conditions, so finish the mission and check the trophy before moving on. No missable flag is stated in the supplied list. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play through Chapter 1 until its completion registers. The trophy list does not name its mission sequence or any point of no return. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Complete Chapter 2 in the story. The supplied description does not specify a route or required optional tasks; confirm the chapter-complete notification before proceeding. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. No chapter mission names or missable conditions are included in the supplied trophy description. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4 and verify the trophy unlock. The list does not say that chapter completion can be missed. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Complete the story's final mission. The supplied list does not name it or disclose whether a choice affects the ending; make a manual save before the finale if you want to preserve a route. The list does not label this trophy missable. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run. The supplied listing does not provide its chapter, prerequisites, or a missable warning. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist and wait for the completion trigger. No approach or optional objective is specified in the listing; no missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Complete the mission Child's Play. The supplied trophy entry does not identify its chapter or any fail-state that would block the trophy. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners. There are no extra medal or choice requirements in the supplied description; no missable warning is given. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. Follow its mission objective through the end trigger; the supplied entry does not name a chapter or warn that replay is unavailable. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory. The list asks only for mission completion, not a medal or a particular approach; no missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Work through the game's 100% completion tracker until it reaches 100%. The supplied trophy list does not enumerate its activity and collectible checklist, so use the in-game completion screen as the authoritative remaining-items list. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts and track the counter in the game. The supplied description does not define qualifying stunt types or provide locations; keep attempting distinct stunt opportunities and check progress periodically. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Enter and try every activity type at least once. The supplied list does not name the types, so consult the in-game activities menu and tick off each category after participating. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in every Shooting Range challenge. The trophy entry gives no challenge count or medal scoring thresholds; repeat each range challenge, improve accuracy and time, and use its result screen to identify what to improve. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each available location. The supplied list does not give a location count or map; mark each race on the in-game map as you find and win it. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Place first in 20 distinct races; repeating one race is not the requirement described. Use the event list to choose races you have not won yet and note the result. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Join a fishing challenge against Cal and finish ahead of him. The listing does not give the meeting location or scoring rule, so follow the challenge prompt and prioritize landing fish until the result declares you the winner. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Play an arcade cabinet through to a completed game; merely starting it is not enough. The trophy description does not name a cabinet or venue. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's mission strand through its final mission. The supplied listing gives no mission title or encounter location; follow the character's marked activities until the strand closes. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission chain and complete its final mission. The trophy entry does not name the mission or say it can be locked out; follow Kenton's available strand prompts. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's strand to its final mission and finish that mission. The supplied text omits the strand's start point and prerequisites; use the map's character markers to continue it. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight separate stranger mission strands around Leonida. A strand means a linked set of missions, not just eight individual tasks; track completed chains in the activity log. No missable condition is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Follow Randy's mission strand to its final mission and complete it. No mission title, start location, or lockout condition appears in the supplied listing. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Continue any available Tyrone strand missions from their map prompts until no further mission remains, then complete the last one. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate once at every meditation spot in Leonida. The supplied trophy entry gives no number or coordinates; use discovered map markers and keep a location checklist until the unlock confirms full coverage. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Take part in Bret's hunt and hunt the unique animal the mission identifies. The listing does not say which species or where it appears; follow Bret's objective marker and use the mission's tracking cues. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Find enough cards to finish three complete Collectible Card sets. The trophy description does not give set sizes or item locations; use the collectible tracker to see which sets remain incomplete. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use WAiNK It at 100 different locations, counting distinct places rather than repeating one. The supplied text does not explain the app's exact interaction; follow its prompt and use its counter to pace the remaining locations. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges from the game's challenge system. The supplied trophy entry does not enumerate them; open the challenge list, choose available objectives, and verify completed status there. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, build a four-star Wanted Level, then evade the search until the wanted level clears. The list does not specify a location or partner; avoid getting arrested or killed before the escape registers. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops consecutively while keeping the same active Wanted Level between robberies. Plan a short route and do not evade police or let the level clear until the third shop is hit. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles and check the vehicle discovery counter for progress. The listing does not state whether variants count separately; encounter and record new models rather than repeatedly using a known one. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Activate Combat Focus when at least five enemies are in reach, then take all five down before that single activation ends. The description does not state a weapon; bring enough ammunition and avoid activating early. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: At VCIA, leave by an unscheduled departure rather than simply following a scheduled travel prompt. The supplied entry does not identify a terminal or vehicle; explore the airport and trigger an improvised exit. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The supplied trophy entry gives only the flavor line, so it does not establish the unlock action or location. Keep this unchecked until the game reveals the Rhino-related objective; the listing does not provide a reliable missable assessment. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Complete a jewelry store robbery without triggering detection. Scout an entry and exit, move quietly, and abandon the attempt if the alarm or witnesses expose you; retry after resetting. The list does not name a store or call this missable. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and successfully escape each robbery. The supplied description does not name banks or require five in one run; record completed vaults and ensure each getaway finishes. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Take an armored truck robbery through the escape phase. The trophy requires getting away, so plan a vehicle and route before engaging; no exact truck spawn or missable condition is given. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore until every region of Leonida is revealed on the map. The entry does not state how regions are counted; travel through fogged areas and review the map for unrevealed gaps. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Find and rob one Illegal Operation tied to every gang. The listing does not name the gangs or their sites; keep a gang-by-gang record from the in-game activity information and confirm each successful robbery. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Order a cocktail somewhere on Ocean Beach where the game recognizes the view condition. The supplied entry does not name a venue; try the beachside bar service and let the view-facing interaction complete. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Cause a forceful exit from a vehicle showroom, using the classic smash-through approach implied by the objective. The trophy text does not specify showroom coordinates or vehicle; look for an accessible showroom and drive through its frontage. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete its follow-through interaction or activity. The supplied entry gives no pin target or score requirement; use the venue prompt and finish a turn. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The supplied entry offers only a hint-like description and no explicit unlock action. Continue partner activities and check the in-game trophy notification; no location or missable status can be confirmed from this listing alone. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: The supplied description does not state the choice or action that unlocks this trophy. Make story decisions as they arise and retain a save before major choices; verify the trigger in-game before relying on any route. Treat its missable status as unknown. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: The entry's hint implies a successful second attempt, but does not identify the activity. When an eligible-looking activity fails, retry it and complete the next attempt; consult the unlock notification for confirmation. Missable status is not established. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: The supplied description points to a strange encounter but does not identify its location or trigger. Explore unusual map events and investigate unexplained encounters; mark the trophy unknown until the game confirms the condition. No reliable missable status is supplied. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: While driving beside a target, use a melee drive-by to knock them down. The description specifies the attack style, not a location; try near a lone pedestrian with room to maneuver and avoid using a firearm. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Use contact-based laundering to earn a cumulative $250,000 from Marked Bills. The supplied listing does not name contacts or conversion rates; check laundering activity and earnings counters, then repeat until the total reaches the target. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a cumulative $100,000 at shops around Leonida. The wording says across all shops, so vary retailers and buy useful upgrades or supplies while tracking the total. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase every garage property shown as available for sale. The entry does not give a count or list of addresses; use the property/map markers and keep buying until the trophy pops. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register ten vehicles through the Scooter Bros app. The listing does not explain registration steps or eligible vehicle types; open the app, follow its add/register prompt, and confirm each vehicle counts. No missable flag is stated. Source: PlayStation trophy list, as supplied for this guide.
